test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

The state or quality of being young
solution:
The correct answer is 'Option 3, Youth'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The group of words denotes the condition or period of someone's life when they are young.(यौवन).
 
• Example: His youth was spent in hardship and poverty.
 
• 'Youth' specifically refers to the time of life when one is young. (यौवन).
 
• Example: The country has a burgeoning youth population.

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 3, Youth'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 'Prenatal' (प्राग्भ्रूण) refers to the period before birth.
 
• 'Puberty' (यौवनावस्था) is the time in life when a child's body develops into an adult's.
 
• 'Solitude' (अकेलापन) means the state of being alone.
